title: UK National Education Union poll: 66% of secondary school teachers in England say pupils using AI are losing their capacity for core skills like writing (Sally Weale/The Guardian)
summary: Sally Weale / The Guardian: UK National Education Union poll: 66% of secondary school teachers in England say pupils using AI are losing their capacity for core skills like writing — Two-thirds of secondary school teachers report a decline in core abilities such as writing and problem-solving
